title: Yellowstone's Upper Loop, then on to Glacier
summary: Finish Yellowstone's Upper 8 loop clockwise, then drive north-west toward West Glacier via Bozeman and Butte.
drive: Canyon Village to West Glacier via Bozeman and Butte · 9h · 720 km

segments.name: Segment 1 — Gibbon Falls to Norris Geyser Basin
segments.blurb: A waterfall and two short-hike geyser basins on the way to Norris.

map.to: Norris Geyser Basin, Yellowstone National Park

stops.name: Gibbon Falls
stops.note: Roadside waterfall on the Gibbon River.

stops.name: Beryl Spring
stops.note: Small, loud hot spring right by the road.

stops.name: Monument Geyser Basin
stops.note: Steep short hike to a ridge of geyser cones.

stops.name: Artists' Paintpots
stops.note: Boardwalk loop past mudpots and hot springs.

stops.name: Norris Geyser Basin
stops.note: Hottest, most acidic basin in the park.

segments.name: Segment 2 — Roaring Mountain to Mammoth Hot Springs
segments.blurb: A steaming hillside, then the park's terraced hot spring complex.

map.to: Mammoth Hot Springs, Yellowstone National Park

stops.name: Roaring Mountain
stops.note: Acidic hillside vented with steam and fumaroles.

stops.name: Cleopatra Spring and Terrace

stops.name: Mammoth Hot Springs

stops.name: Slough Creek

stops.name: Mount Washburn
